sinners | january 2026


i enjoyed the ending of this movie (and i've been getting teary eyed when listening to the beginning of "Last Time (I Seen the Sun)" for the past couple of days. i hope it does well this awards season!


besides the social commentary, i thought the vampires singing was funny at moments. would rewatch!

attack on titan | january 2026


i'm not entirely sure where to go with this one. i'm watching AoT with my boyfriend, and we finally got past the first and second seasons over the weekend.


i like it so far. my favorite characters are Hange and Sasha ^_^ there are some minor complaints from me about pacing, but overall i'm enjoying watching his favorite show with him!

--------------- ☄. *. ⋆ december 2025

sword art online: alicization | december 2025


i was DELIGHTFULLY surprised by the entirety of alicization (including war of the underworld). i think, honestly, this is the best that SAO has to offer. it has wonderful action scenes, enjoyable kirito and eugeo moments, and the classic SAO heartstring-tugging. my only complaint is an upsetting scene involving Ronye and Tiese near the end of the first arc :(
